description: NYISO (New York) zonal LMP (locational marginal price, $/MWh) for the most recent published day, broken down by load zone (CAPITL, CENTRL, DUNWOD, GENESE, HUD VL, LONGIL, MHK VL, MILLWD, N.Y.C., NORTH, WEST). Returns LBMP, marginal cost of losses, marginal cost of congestion per 5-min interval. Use for NY wholesale electricity prices, zonal congestion analysis.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD (NY local). Defaults to yesterday — today's file may not be published yet.

zone.description: Optional zone filter, e.g. "N.Y.C." or "CAPITL". Default: all 11 zones.

name: nyiso_lmp_zonal
title: Nyiso Lmp Zonal
